notes:
Drone monitoring is in Settings. Drone swarm detection warns when Remote ID detects new drones in the time window you set. Drone perimeter detection warns when a drone using Remote ID is inside the distance you pick: 100 m, 250 m, 500 m, or 1 km. It starts at 250 m and needs a GPS fix of 50 m or better. Beep and voice are on until you turn them off. System notification is off until you turn it on. The warning still opens if those are off. The live row says within that distance while the drone is still inside.

Low battery protection mode is off until you turn it on. A low battery slows the scan to Battery saver, then can stop it. The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth icons turn yellow while Battery saver is on. Plugging in undoes the slow-down. A stop stays stopped until you open Fieldwatch.

Tracker monitoring beeps and speaks when a warning first opens. Both are on until you turn one off. System notification is off until you turn it on. The popup still opens if those are off. Separated tag with you says a tracking tag is away from its owner, how long this phone has heard it, and at how many places. Heard at two places says a tracking tag was heard where this phone was.

These warnings are a guide, not proof. Fieldwatch will not catch every tracker, and a warning does not mean someone is tracking you. If you think you are in danger, contact local law enforcement.

The Settings list calls that section Signature watchlist alerts.

The stock catalog names more radios. Two-way radios are in, and none of them beep. Mentra Live glasses, the Steiner M830 LRF binocular, and TBS Crossfire do beep. The other new rows do not. Brilliant Frame is now Brilliant Labs glasses (Frame / Halo). Even G1 is now Even Realities G1 / G2. Apple AirTags is now Find My (AirTag or other Apple). Update stock catalog from GitHub pulls the new signature file. A phone still on 1.1.44 keeps using the older file.

Bundled language files are written for this version.
